title: p.apyr.us docs: key URLs on the Item type (urls.types), sections as topics, and the section migration (follow-up of PPY-a6acd2)
description: Write the p.apyr.us docs page for the engine change in PPY-a6acd2: urls.types (keying a URL base and listing on the Item type), urls.sections.<id>.aliases, sections as topics (collections select.sections), the dry-run section migration (python -m papyrus_content.section_migration) and the URL comparison (python -m papyrus_content.projection.url_compare). Source text is docs/building-a-papyrus-static-site.md (Sections and types) and docs/content-item-lifecycle.md (Story types and sections).
